FAQ about 1080p screen recording

Can you screen record in 1080p?

Yes, Loom allows you to screen record in sharp 1080p resolution, ensuring high-quality videos. You can choose this option when setting up your recording preferences.

Can I add captions or subtitles to my 1080p recordings?

Yes, Loom offers the ability to add captions or subtitles to your 1080p video. You can either manually input the captions or enable automatic transcription, which generates captions based on the audio.

How can I share my 1080p recordings with a team?

With Loom, sharing your 1080p video is simple. You can generate a shareable link to send to your team members, or you can directly embed the video into platforms like Slack, Google Docs, or email. Additionally, Loom allows you to control privacy settings, so you can decide who has access to view, comment, or download the video.

How do I save my 1080p screen recordings for future use?

Loom stores all your 1080p recordings in in your cloud-based video library, so they are easily accessible for future reference or sharing.

Can I edit my 1080p screen recording?

Absolutely! Loom provides editing features that allow you to enhance, trim, and perfect your 1080p recordings for a polished and professional finish.
